'''Agent Amber Kearnen''' is a member of [[SI:7]] and a quest giver in [[Westfall]] spying on [[Klaven's Tower|an abandoned Alliance watch tower]] in the southeastern part of the [[Dust Plains]] that has been taken over by the [[Defias Brotherhood]]. She is involved in helping rogues sent by [[Mathias Shaw]] infiltrate the tower and retrieve the journal of [[Klaven Mortwake]]. According to her [[Kearnen's Journal|journal]] her rank is Ground Level Operative, R8 (R8 most likely standing for Rank 8).
